sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of vintage-inspired charm to your daily look with our Textured Bow Necklace. Featuring a beautifully detailed ribbon pendant and a shimmering twisted chain, this piece is the ultimate high-fashion accessory for those who love romantic, trendy styling. To keep its golden glow radiant for as long as possible, we recommend treating this delicate piece with love: keep it away from moisture and store it in a dry, safe place after each wear.
